en.t: The woman blew out the candle again.

units.source_text: 虽说是透过玻璃窗瞥了一眼，但颇似那个京都的美女。

en.t: Though I had only glimpsed her through the glass window, she looked very much like that beautiful woman from Kyoto.

units.source_text: 然而，男人却不是上次的那个男人。

en.t: However, the man was not the same man as before.
